sequenceReference.note: This package opens only the repository first-child boundary that a future generated-SDK package would need. It does not narrow, close or execute step 3 of the pinned sequence, and it does not supersede planning/gj01-generated-sdk-protocol-readiness.json, which remains the frozen protocol target.

goal: Move `sdk` from the repository root's forbidden first-children-of-src set to its permitted set, so a future, separately authorized generation package has a boundary to write into. Introduces no generator, no generated client, no populated src/sdk tree and no delivery surface.

boundaryChange.note: src/adapters and src/delivery remain refused by name; opening them is a separate, still-unopened decision. This package moves exactly one name across the line, the way src/application moved for P-M1-02.

nextPackage.note: A future, separately scoped, single-writer generation package may target src/sdk, and only src/sdk, once this package is GREEN and separately approved by Codex MASTER. That package must regenerate byte-identically from the frozen protocol contract in planning/gj01-generated-sdk-protocol-readiness.json.
preconditions: npm test and npm run check are GREEN on this package
separate Codex MASTER approval is recorded
the generation package is scoped test-first with its own allowedFiles, non-goals, RED/GREEN and rollback

nonGoals: no src/sdk directory or file is created in this package
no code generator, no generation tooling
no generated SDK client code of any kind
no change to src/application or src/domain source
no change to src/adapters or src/delivery boundary (both remain forbidden)
no ASGI, Uvicorn, Hypercorn or FastAPI delivery surface
no app, module or release/deploy/publish path
no version bump, no README change, no CI change
no readiness, MVP, buildable, releasable, deployable or production claim anywhere in this package

red.note: Before the checker is updated, the test suite expects sdk permitted while the checker still forbids it, so the targeted run fails on the boundary-authority rows.

requirements: npm run check must be GREEN

rollback.trigger: the boundary change, the flags block or the non-goals set drifts from this record
rollback.action: revert planning/gj01-src-sdk-boundary-authority.json, tools/check-repository-boundary.mjs, tests/repository-boundary.test.mjs, db/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.json, tests/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.test.mjs and the CHANGELOG.md entry as one six-file shard. The two substrate files were added under the same package after full QA showed tools/check-kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.mjs re-imports and re-checks this same shared root-source-topology fence from db/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.json#rootSourceTopology; reverting only the original four files would leave that mirrored contract pinned to the pre-boundary-authority domain/application-only topology and out of sync with the fence it re-exports.
